Query: SELECT `chairs`.`id`,`chairs`.`name`,`chairs`.`model`,`location`.`latitude`,`location`.`longitude` FROM `chairs` JOIN `chair_locations` AS `location` ON `location`.`id` = (SELECT `id` FROM `chair_locations` WHERE `chair_id` = `chairs`.`id` ORDER BY `created_at` DESC LIMIT N) WHERE `chairs`.`is_active` = N

SELECT `rides`.`chair_id`,`latest_status`.`status` FROM (`rides` JOIN `chairs` ON `chairs`.`id` = `rides`.`chair_id` AND `chairs`.`is_active` = N) LEFT JOIN `ride_statuses` AS `latest_status` ON `latest_status`.`id` = (SELECT `id` FROM `ride_statuses` WHERE `ride_id` = `rides`.`id` ORDER BY `created_at` DESC LIMIT N) WHERE `latest_status`.`status` IS NULL OR `latest_status`.`status` != 'S' ORDER BY `rides`.`created_at` DESC
SELECT `id`,`user_id` FROM `rides` WHERE `chair_id` IS NULL ORDER BY `created_at`,`id` LIMIT N for update

INSERT INTO `chair_distance_totals` (`chair_id`,`total_distance`,`last_latitude`,`last_longitude`,`updated_at`) SELECT `chairs`.`id`,IFNULL(`locations`.`total_distance`, N),`locations`.`latitude`,`locations`.`longitude`,`locations`.`created_at` FROM `chairs` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `chair_id`,`latitude`,`longitude`,`created_at`,SUM(IFNULL(`distance`, N)) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id`) AS `total_distance`,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at` DESC,`id` DESC) AS `latest` FROM (SELECT `id`,`chair_id`,`latitude`,`longitude`,`created_at`,ABS(`latitude` - LAG(`latitude`) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at`,`id`)) + ABS(`longitude` - LAG(`longitude`) OVER (PARTITION BY `chair_id` ORDER BY `created_at`,`id`)) AS `distance` FROM `chair_locations`) AS `distances`) AS `locations` ON `locations`.`chair_id` = `chairs`.`id` AND `locations`.`latest` = N

SELECT `c`.`id` FROM `chairs` AS `c` LEFT JOIN `rides` AS `previous` ON `previous`.`id` = (SELECT `id` FROM `rides` WHERE `chair_id` = `c`.`id` ORDER BY `updated_at` DESC,`id` DESC LIMIT N) WHERE `c`.`is_active` = N AND (`previous`.`id` IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT N FROM `ride_statuses` WHERE `ride_id` = `previous`.`id` AND `status` = 'S') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT N FROM `ride_statuses` WHERE `ride_id` = `previous`.`id` AND `chair_sent_at` IS NULL)))
